SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu

13. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely
